remarks: Enjoy Rowayton amenities at 15 Old Witch Court. This renovated 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom colonial is available for short term or yearly rental. With 2,080 sqft this colonial has undergone extensive updates since its purchase in 2019, including white oak floors, a new kitchen and updated baths.  The main level features a modern kitchen with a large island and adjacent dining area, as well as a warm inviting family room with wood burning fireplace. This space opens to a large covered porch overlooking the backyard. Additionally, the main level includes a generously-sized living room and a full bath. Upstairs, you'll find four comfortable bedrooms that share a second full bath. The lower level laundry area is adjacent to a workbench area and storage options. This home offers a spacious layout with attached two car garage and is located in the desirable Old Witch Court neighborhood with access to all of Rowayton's amenities.
